COMPACT_CONTEXT_THRESHOLD.description: The context size, in tokens, of the first nudge; 0 turns the size check off
COMPACT_CONTEXT_THRESHOLD.whenUnset: 250000 on a window of 1M or more, 160000 on a smaller one

COMPACT_CONTEXT_INTERVAL.description: The context, in tokens, between one nudge's level and the next
COMPACT_CONTEXT_INTERVAL.whenUnset: COMPACT_CONTEXT_THRESHOLD's, so the nudges come at its multiples

COMPACT_THRESHOLD.description: The edits and writes before the count's first nudge

COMPACT_INTERVAL.description: The edits and writes between the count's nudges
COMPACT_INTERVAL.whenUnset: COMPACT_THRESHOLD's, so the nudges come at its multiples

COMPACT_STATE_TTL_DAYS.description: The age, in days, at which other sessions' state files are swept

ECC_CONTEXT_WINDOW_TOKENS.description: The context window, in tokens, for a model whose window the hook guesses wrong
ECC_CONTEXT_WINDOW_TOKENS.whenUnset: CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW if set, else the model's window as the hook detects it
